question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cautios"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be spelled as **"Cautious"**. (सावधान)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** Being careful to avoid potential danger or risks.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** सावधान
 
• **Example:** She was very cautious while crossing the busy road.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling is **"Cautious"**. (सावधान)
 
 
• **Example:** The team took cautious steps to ensure the project’s success.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Anxious** (चिंतित): Feeling worried or nervous about something uncertain.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt anxious before her big presentation.
 
 
 
• **Curious** (जिज्ञासु): Having a strong desire to learn or know something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was curious to know how the machine worked.
 
 
 
• **Bashful** (शर्मीला): Shy or reluctant to draw attention to oneself.
 
 
• **Example:** The bashful boy hesitated to speak in front of the class.
